notes.zh-CN:
‧新增“稍后再问”时间设置。
‧调整“暂停轮替”为“暂停换角色”，并新增继续换角色按钮。
‧调整设置页分类。
‧优化断线重连判定。
‧优化自动重连的状态显示。
‧优化角色是否在游戏中的判定。
‧优化屏幕被系统关闭时的处理。
‧优化定时回报内容。
‧优化换角色询问，防止误点。
‧修复角色被退回选角画面时未自动处理的问题。
‧修复换角色未成功仍显示已换到的问题。
‧修复切换到已挂满角色时直接被换走的问题。
‧修复换角色时误报游戏窗口被最小化的问题。
‧修复定时回报显示已关闭窗口的问题。
‧修复重新连线后指令送错窗口的问题。
notes.EN:
‧Added: a setting for the "ask later" time.
‧Changed: "Pause rotation" in the switch question is now "Pause switching", with a new "Continue switching" button.
‧Changed: the settings page is grouped differently.
‧Improved: detection of lost connections and reconnecting.
‧Improved: the reconnect shows each step it is on.
‧Improved: telling whether the character is really in the game.
‧Improved: handling when the system turns the display off.
‧Improved: the timed report.
‧Improved: the switch question guards against accidental clicks.
‧Fixed: a character sent back to the character screen was not handled automatically.
‧Fixed: a switch that did not get into the game still said it had switched.
‧Fixed: switching to a character already done today switched away at once.
‧Fixed: switching wrongly reported the game window as minimized.
‧Fixed: the timed report listed closed game windows.
‧Fixed: after a reconnect some commands went to the old game window.
